# Radio

Radio buttons let people select one option from a set of options.

**Example: A radio group for choosing a delivery address**

```html
<div role="radiogroup" aria-label="Delivery address">
  <div>
    <md-gb-radio id="home" name="address" value="home" checked></md-gb-radio>
    <label for="home">Home</label>
  </div>
  <div>
    <md-gb-radio id="office" name="address" value="office"></md-gb-radio>
    <label for="office">Office</label>
  </div>
</div>
```

## Usage guidelines

*   **Use radios for a single choice.** Pick radio buttons, not switches, when only one option can be selected from a list; use checkboxes when several can.
*   **Show every option.** Radios expose all the choices, so use them for five or fewer; consider a menu when space is tight.
*   **Always add a label.** Each radio needs its own scannable label, and a person can select either the radio or its label.
*   **Preselect one and stack them.** List radios vertically with one option already selected, and avoid nesting them.

## Anatomy

A radio is one element, paired with an adjacent label.

**Example: A radio button with its label**

```html
<md-gb-radio id="anatomy-radio" name="anatomy" value="email" checked></md-gb-radio>
<label for="anatomy-radio">Email</label>
```

## Examples

### Group

Radios with the same `name` form a group, and only one can be selected. Add `checked` to the one selected at the start, and `value` to identify the selection in a form.

**Example: A group of three radios in a form**

```html
<form>
  <div role="radiogroup" aria-label="Pet">
    <div>
      <md-gb-radio id="cats" name="pet" value="cats"></md-gb-radio>
      <label for="cats">Cats</label>
    </div>
    <div>
      <md-gb-radio id="dogs" name="pet" value="dogs" checked></md-gb-radio>
      <label for="dogs">Dogs</label>
    </div>
    <div>
      <md-gb-radio id="birds" name="pet" value="birds"></md-gb-radio>
      <label for="birds">Birds</label>
    </div>
  </div>
</form>
```

### Required

Add `required` to any radio in the group to require a selection before the form submits.

**Example: A required radio group**

```html
<form>
  <div role="radiogroup" aria-label="Plan">
    <div>
      <md-gb-radio id="monthly" name="plan" value="monthly" required></md-gb-radio>
      <label for="monthly">Monthly</label>
    </div>
    <div>
      <md-gb-radio id="yearly" name="plan" value="yearly"></md-gb-radio>
      <label for="yearly">Yearly</label>
    </div>
  </div>
</form>
```

### Disabled

Add `disabled` to a radio that can't be selected right now.

**Example: A radio group with a disabled option**

```html
<div role="radiogroup" aria-label="Shipping">
  <div>
    <md-gb-radio id="standard" name="shipping" checked></md-gb-radio>
    <label for="standard">Standard</label>
  </div>
  <div>
    <md-gb-radio id="express" name="shipping" disabled></md-gb-radio>
    <label for="express">Express</label>
  </div>
</div>
```

### Density

Set `density` from `0` (default) down to `-3` to shrink the radio by 4px per step. The touch target stays 48px. Keep it off by default and let people opt in.

**Example: A radio group at density -2**

```html
<div role="radiogroup" aria-label="Size">
  <div>
    <md-gb-radio id="small" name="size" density="-2" checked></md-gb-radio>
    <label for="small">Small</label>
  </div>
  <div>
    <md-gb-radio id="large" name="size" density="-2"></md-gb-radio>
    <label for="large">Large</label>
  </div>
</div>
```

## Accessibility

*   Place radios in a [`role="radiogroup"`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Accessibility/ARIA/Roles/radiogroup_role) and label the group with `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`.
*   Name each radio with a `<label for>` that points at its `id`. Use an [`aria-label`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Accessibility/ARIA/Attributes/aria-label) only for a radio with no visible label.
*   Don't wrap a radio in its `<label>`; screen readers then can't announce the number of radios in the group.
*   Tab moves focus to the selected radio of a group, and the arrow keys move the selection between radios. Space selects the focused radio.
*   Once a radio is selected the group can't be cleared, so add a "None" option or a "Clear selection" control if people may opt out.

## API reference

### &lt;md-gb-radio&gt;

A Material Design component.

#### Properties

| Property | Attribute | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <code>checked</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Whether or not the radio is selected.</span> | <code>checked</code> | <code>boolean</code> |  |
| <code>density</code><br><span class="gb-desc">The density, from 0 (default) to -3. Each step down removes 4px from the radio's layout box (48px) and state layer (40px); the touch target stays 48px. Values are clamped to that range. radio-button.md: don't apply density by default; let people opt in to a denser layout.</span> | <code>density</code> | <code>Density</code> |  |
| <code>required</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Whether or not the radio is required. If any radio is required in a group, all radios are implicitly required.</span> | <code>required</code> | <code>boolean</code> | <code>false</code> |
| <code>value</code><br><span class="gb-desc">The element value to use in form submission when checked.</span> | <code>value</code> | <code>string</code> | <code>'on'</code> |

#### Events

| Event | Description |
| --- | --- |
| <code>change</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Event</span> | Fired when the radio is checked (but not unchecked). |
| <code>input</code><br><span class="gb-desc">InputEvent</span> | Fired when the radio is checked (but not unchecked). |

#### CSS parts

| Part | Description |
| --- | --- |
| <code>::part(radio)</code> | The radio's root element. |

#### CSS custom properties

| Property | Description |
| --- | --- |
| <code>--density-step</code> | Size removed per density step. |
| <code>--icon-color</code> |  |
| <code>--icon-size</code> |  |
| <code>--state-layer-color</code> |  |
| <code>--state-layer-shape</code> |  |
| <code>--state-layer-size</code> | State layer size at density 0. |
| <code>--target-size</code> | The minimum touch target size, kept at any density. |

---

Source: https://material-web.dev/3.0/components/search/

# Search

A search bar lets people enter a query and find matching results, with a search view that shows suggestions and results.

**Example: A search bar with recipe suggestions**

```html
<md-gb-search-bar placeholder="Search recipes">
  <md-gb-list-item static role="option">
    <md-gb-icon slot="leading">history</md-gb-icon>
    Mexican dishes
  </md-gb-list-item>
  <md-gb-list-item static role="option">
    <md-gb-icon slot="leading">history</md-gb-icon>
    Peanut sauce
  </md-gb-list-item>
  <md-gb-list-item static role="option">
    <md-gb-icon slot="leading">search</md-gb-icon>
    Pasta recipes
  </md-gb-list-item>
</md-gb-search-bar>
```

## Usage guidelines

*   **Use it to navigate with queries.** Search is the entry point for finding content in a product by typing.
*   **Hint what to search.** A bar can show hinted text such as "Search recipes", a leading icon and up to two [trailing](#trailing-elements) icons.
*   **Suggest as people type.** The view lists suggestions or results below the bar as the query changes.
*   **Choose a style.** The contained style is recommended; the [divided](#divided) style puts a divider between the header and the results.
*   **Make it prominent.** A [search app bar](#search-app-bar) gives search an emphasized, global entry point.

This component is new in [M3 Expressive](https://m3.material.io/blog/building-with-m3-expressive).

## Anatomy

A search bar holds the leading and trailing elements; its default slot holds the suggestions or results shown in its search view.

**Example: A search bar with leading, trailing and view trailing buttons and suggestions**

```html
<md-gb-search-bar placeholder="Search recipes">
  <md-gb-icon-button slot="leading" aria-label="Open menu">
    <md-gb-icon>menu</md-gb-icon>
  </md-gb-icon-button>
  <md-gb-icon-button slot="trailing" aria-label="Voice search">
    <md-gb-icon>mic</md-gb-icon>
  </md-gb-icon-button>
  <md-gb-icon-button slot="view-trailing" aria-label="Voice search">
    <md-gb-icon>mic</md-gb-icon>
  </md-gb-icon-button>
  <md-gb-list-item static role="option">
    <md-gb-icon slot="leading">history</md-gb-icon>
    Mexican dishes
  </md-gb-list-item>
  <md-gb-list-item static role="option">
    <md-gb-icon slot="leading">search</md-gb-icon>
    Pasta recipes
  </md-gb-list-item>
</md-gb-search-bar>
```

## Examples

### Trailing elements

Put up to two icon buttons in the `trailing` slot, or an avatar in the `avatar` slot. A `leading` icon button, such as a menu button, replaces the default search icon.

**Example: A search bar with a menu button and a voice search button**

```html
<md-gb-search-bar placeholder="Search messages">
  <md-gb-icon-button slot="leading" aria-label="Open menu">
    <md-gb-icon>menu</md-gb-icon>
  </md-gb-icon-button>
  <md-gb-icon-button slot="trailing" aria-label="Voice search">
    <md-gb-icon>mic</md-gb-icon>
  </md-gb-icon-button>
</md-gb-search-bar>
```

### Docked

Add `docked` to open the view as a drop-down below the bar, for medium and larger windows. Without it, the view opens full-screen.

**Example: A docked search bar**

```html
<md-gb-search-bar docked placeholder="Search recipes">
  <md-gb-list-item static role="option">
    <md-gb-icon slot="leading">search</md-gb-icon>
    Pancakes
  </md-gb-list-item>
  <md-gb-list-item static role="option">
    <md-gb-icon slot="leading">search</md-gb-icon>
    Pad thai
  </md-gb-list-item>
</md-gb-search-bar>
```

### Divided

Add `divided` to use the baseline style, with a divider between the view's header and its results.

**Example: A search bar with a divided view**

```html
<md-gb-search-bar divided placeholder="Search recipes">
  <md-gb-list-item static role="option">
    <md-gb-icon slot="leading">history</md-gb-icon>
    Plants
  </md-gb-list-item>
  <md-gb-list-item static role="option">
    <md-gb-icon slot="leading">search</md-gb-icon>
    Pasta recipes
  </md-gb-list-item>
</md-gb-search-bar>
```

### Search app bar

Put a search bar in the `search` slot of an [app bar](/material-web/3.0/components/app-bar/) with `variant="search"`. The app bar draws the container, so make the bar's container transparent.

**Example: A search app bar with a profile button**

```html
<md-gb-app-bar variant="search">
  <md-gb-search-bar slot="search" placeholder="Search recipes" style="--container-color: transparent"></md-gb-search-bar>
  <md-gb-icon-button slot="trailing" aria-label="Profile">
    <md-gb-icon>account_circle</md-gb-icon>
  </md-gb-icon-button>
</md-gb-app-bar>
```

### Standalone search view

Use `md-gb-search-view` on its own for a search that opens from an icon button. Set `open` from the button.

**Example: An icon button that opens a search view**

*HTML*

```html
<md-gb-icon-button id="open-search" aria-label="Search">
  <md-gb-icon>search</md-gb-icon>
</md-gb-icon-button>
<md-gb-search-view id="recipes" placeholder="Search recipes">
  <md-gb-list-item static role="option">
    <md-gb-icon slot="leading">history</md-gb-icon>
    Mexican dishes
  </md-gb-list-item>
  <md-gb-list-item static role="option">
    <md-gb-icon slot="leading">search</md-gb-icon>
    Pad thai
  </md-gb-list-item>
</md-gb-search-view>
```

*JavaScript*

```js
document.querySelector('#open-search').addEventListener('click', () => {
  document.querySelector('#recipes').open = true;
});
```

### Searching

Set `searching` while you wait for results. The view shows a progress indicator and marks the results as busy.

**Example: A search bar that shows it is searching for a second**

*HTML*

```html
<md-gb-search-bar placeholder="Search recipes"></md-gb-search-bar>
```

*JavaScript*

```js
const bar = document.querySelector('md-gb-search-bar');
const loadResults = (query) => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 1000));
bar.addEventListener('search', async (event) => {
  bar.searching = true;
  await loadResults(event.detail.value);
  bar.searching = false;
});
```

## Accessibility

*   The bar's input and the view's input are comboboxes, and the suggestions are the options of a `listbox`. Slotted results without a role get `role="option"`.
*   Enter, the Down arrow or typing opens the view. The back button and Escape close it.
*   The input is named by `label`, which defaults to `placeholder`. Set `label` when the hint isn't a good name.
*   Give icon buttons in the slots an `aria-label`, such as "Voice search".
*   Change `back-label`, `clear-label`, `results-label` and `searching-label` when you translate the page. Announce changing results with `suggestions-label`.

## API reference

### &lt;md-gb-search-bar&gt;

A Material Design search bar.

#### Properties

| Property | Attribute | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <code>backLabel</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Accessible label of the view's back button.</span> | <code>back-label</code> | <code>string</code> | <code>'Back'</code> |
| <code>clearLabel</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Accessible label of the view's clear button.</span> | <code>clear-label</code> | <code>string</code> | <code>'Clear search'</code> |
| <code>disabled</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Whether the search bar is disabled.</span> | <code>disabled</code> | <code>boolean</code> | <code>false</code> |
| <code>divided</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Uses the divided (baseline) view style.</span> | <code>divided</code> | <code>boolean</code> | <code>false</code> |
| <code>docked</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Opens the view docked below the bar, for medium and larger windows. Otherwise it opens full-screen.</span> | <code>docked</code> | <code>boolean</code> | <code>false</code> |
| <code>expanded</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Whether the search view is open.</span> | <code>expanded</code> | <code>boolean</code> |  |
| <code>label</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Accessible label of the inputs. Defaults to <code>placeholder</code>, per the spec.</span> | <code>label</code> | <code>string</code> | <code>''</code> |
| <code>placeholder</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Hinted search text, e.g. "Search messages".</span> | <code>placeholder</code> | <code>string</code> | <code>''</code> |
| <code>quick</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Whether to skip the open and close animations.</span> | <code>quick</code> | <code>boolean</code> | <code>false</code> |
| <code>resultsLabel</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Accessible label of the results listbox.</span> | <code>results-label</code> | <code>string</code> | <code>'Search results'</code> |
| <code>searching</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Whether the app is searching: shows progress in the view.</span> | <code>searching</code> | <code>boolean</code> | <code>false</code> |
| <code>searchingLabel</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Accessible label of the searching progress indicator.</span> | <code>searching-label</code> | <code>string</code> | <code>'Searching'</code> |
| <code>suggestionsLabel</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Announced when suggestions or results become available.</span> | <code>suggestions-label</code> | <code>string</code> | <code>'Suggestions available'</code> |
| <code>value</code><br><span class="gb-desc">The search text. Shared with the view.</span> | <code>value</code> | <code>string</code> | <code>''</code> |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| default | Search suggestions or results, shown in the view. Use elements with <code>role="option"</code>; slotted elements without a role get it. |
| <code>avatar</code> | A trailing avatar image. |
| <code>leading</code> | A navigation icon button. Defaults to a non-functional search icon. |
| <code>trailing</code> | Up to two trailing icons or icon buttons. |
| <code>view-trailing</code> | Trailing icon buttons in the view's header. |

#### Events

| Event | Description |
| --- | --- |
| <code>change</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Event</span> | Fired when the search text is committed. |
| <code>close</code><br><span class="gb-desc">CustomEvent&lt;&#123;reason: string&#125;&gt;</span> | Fired when the view begins closing. Cancelable. |
| <code>closed</code><br><span class="gb-desc">CustomEvent&lt;&#123;reason: string&#125;&gt;</span> | Fired when the view has closed. |
| <code>input</code><br><span class="gb-desc">InputEvent</span> | Fired when the search text changes. |
| <code>open</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Event</span> | Fired when the view begins opening. Cancelable. |
| <code>opened</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Event</span> | Fired when the view has opened and animations finished. |
| <code>search</code><br><span class="gb-desc">CustomEvent&lt;&#123;value: string&#125;&gt;</span> | Fired when a search is executed with Enter in the view. |

#### Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| <code>close</code><br><span class="gb-desc">(reason?: string) =&gt; Promise&lt;void&gt;</span> | Closes the search view. |
| <code>focus</code><br><span class="gb-desc">(options?: FocusOptions) =&gt; void</span> | Focuses the search bar input. |
| <code>render</code><br><span class="gb-desc">() =&gt; TemplateResult&lt;1&gt;</span> | Invoked on each update to perform rendering tasks. This method may return any value renderable by lit-html's <code>ChildPart</code> - typically a <code>TemplateResult</code>. Setting properties inside this method will *not* trigger the element to update. |
| <code>show</code><br><span class="gb-desc">() =&gt; Promise&lt;void&gt;</span> | Opens the search view. |

#### CSS parts

| Part | Description |
| --- | --- |
| <code>::part(bar)</code> | The search bar container. |
| <code>::part(input)</code> | The search bar input. |
| <code>::part(view)</code> | The <code>md-gb-search-view</code>. |

### &lt;md-gb-search-view&gt;

Focused search: suggestions or results opened from a search bar.

#### Properties

| Property | Attribute | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <code>backLabel</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Accessible label of the back button.</span> | <code>back-label</code> | <code>string</code> | <code>'Back'</code> |
| <code>bar</code><br><span class="gb-desc">The search bar the view expands from. Docked, the view is positioned over it.</span> |  | <code>HTMLElement</code> | <code>null</code> |

| <code>docked</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Docked layout: a drop-down below the search bar over a scrim. Otherwise the view is full-screen.</span> | <code>docked</code> | <code>boolean</code> | <code>false</code> |
| <code>label</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Accessible label of the input and dialog. Defaults to <code>placeholder</code>.</span> | <code>label</code> | <code>string</code> | <code>''</code> |
| <code>open</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Whether the view is open.</span> | <code>open</code> | <code>boolean</code> |  |
| <code>placeholder</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Hinted search text.</span> | <code>placeholder</code> | <code>string</code> | <code>''</code> |
| <code>quick</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Whether to skip the open and close animations.</span> | <code>quick</code> | <code>boolean</code> | <code>false</code> |
| <code>resultsLabel</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Accessible label of the results listbox.</span> | <code>results-label</code> | <code>string</code> | <code>'Search results'</code> |
| <code>searching</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Whether the app is searching: shows a progress indicator under the header and marks the results busy for assistive technology.</span> | <code>searching</code> | <code>boolean</code> | <code>false</code> |
| <code>searchingLabel</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Accessible label of the searching progress indicator.</span> | <code>searching-label</code> | <code>string</code> | <code>'Searching'</code> |
| <code>suggestionsLabel</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Announced when suggestions or results become available.</span> | <code>suggestions-label</code> | <code>string</code> | <code>'Suggestions available'</code> |
| <code>value</code><br><span class="gb-desc">The search text.</span> | <code>value</code> | <code>string</code> | <code>''</code> |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| default | Search suggestions or results. |
| <code>leading</code> | Replaces the back icon button. |
| <code>trailing</code> | Trailing icons or icon buttons, after the clear button. |

#### Events

| Event | Description |
| --- | --- |
| <code>change</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Event</span> | Fired when the input text is committed. |
| <code>close</code><br><span class="gb-desc">CustomEvent&lt;&#123;reason: string&#125;&gt;</span> | Fired when the view begins closing. Cancelable. See <code>SEARCH_CLOSE_REASONS</code>. |
| <code>closed</code><br><span class="gb-desc">CustomEvent&lt;&#123;reason: string&#125;&gt;</span> | Fired when the view has closed. |
| <code>input</code><br><span class="gb-desc">InputEvent</span> | Fired when the input text changes. |
| <code>open</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Event</span> | Fired when the view begins opening. Cancelable. |
| <code>opened</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Event</span> | Fired when the view has opened and animations finished. |
| <code>search</code><br><span class="gb-desc">CustomEvent&lt;&#123;value: string&#125;&gt;</span> | Fired when a search is executed with Enter. |

#### Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| <code>clear</code><br><span class="gb-desc">() =&gt; void</span> | Clears the search text and focuses the input. |
| <code>close</code><br><span class="gb-desc">(reason?: string) =&gt; Promise&lt;void&gt;</span> | Closes the view. |
| <code>focus</code><br><span class="gb-desc">(options?: FocusOptions) =&gt; void</span> | Focuses the search input. |
| <code>handleBack</code><br><span class="gb-desc">() =&gt; Promise&lt;void&gt;</span> | Handles a back request (the Android back gesture or button, which the view receives through its dialog): a full-screen view plays the predictive back motion, then the view closes with reason <code>back</code>. Call it for an in-app back control that should behave like the system back. |
| <code>render</code><br><span class="gb-desc">() =&gt; TemplateResult&lt;1&gt;</span> | Invoked on each update to perform rendering tasks. This method may return any value renderable by lit-html's <code>ChildPart</code> - typically a <code>TemplateResult</code>. Setting properties inside this method will *not* trigger the element to update. |
| <code>show</code><br><span class="gb-desc">() =&gt; Promise&lt;void&gt;</span> | Opens the view. |

#### CSS parts

| Part | Description |
| --- | --- |
| <code>::part(container)</code> | The view's container. |
| <code>::part(dialog)</code> | The modal <code>&lt;dialog&gt;</code>. |
| <code>::part(divider)</code> | The divider of the divided style. |
| <code>::part(header)</code> | The header with the input. |
| <code>::part(input)</code> | The search input. |
| <code>::part(results)</code> | The <code>role="listbox"</code> results container. |

| <code>--bar-results-gap</code> | Contained docked gap between the bar and results. |
| <code>--bar-shape</code> | Contained bar shape. |
| <code>--contained-background-color</code> | Contained full-screen background color. |
| <code>--contained-icon-label-gap</code> | Space between the icon targets and the input. |
| <code>--contained-leading-margin</code> | Contained full-screen bar leading margin. |
| <code>--contained-motion-duration</code> | Contained expand and collapse duration. |
| <code>--contained-motion-spring</code> | Contained expand and collapse easing. |
| <code>--contained-trailing-margin</code> | Contained full-screen bar trailing margin. |
| <code>--container-color</code> | Container color. |
| <code>--container-shape</code> | Container shape. |
| <code>--content-fade-in-delay</code> | Results fade in delay. |
| <code>--content-fade-in-duration</code> | Results fade in duration. |
| <code>--content-fade-in-easing</code> | Results fade in easing. |
| <code>--content-fade-out-duration</code> | Results fade out duration. |
| <code>--content-fade-out-easing</code> | Results fade out easing. |
| <code>--divided-collapse-motion-duration</code> | Divided collapse duration. |
| <code>--divided-collapse-motion-spring</code> | Divided collapse easing. |
| <code>--divided-expand-motion-duration</code> | Divided expand duration. |
| <code>--divided-expand-motion-spring</code> | Divided expand easing. |
| <code>--divider-color</code> | Divided style divider color. |
| <code>--header-container-height</code> | Header height. |
| <code>--header-input-text</code> | Input typography. |
| <code>--header-input-text-axes</code> | Input font variation settings. |
| <code>--header-input-text-color</code> | Input text color. |
| <code>--header-input-text-tracking</code> | Input letter spacing. |
| <code>--header-leading-icon-color</code> | Back icon color. |
| <code>--header-supporting-text</code> | Placeholder typography. |
| <code>--header-supporting-text-axes</code> | Placeholder font variation settings. |
| <code>--header-supporting-text-color</code> | Placeholder color. |
| <code>--header-supporting-text-tracking</code> | Placeholder letter spacing. |
| <code>--header-trailing-icon-color</code> | Trailing icon color. |
| <code>--icon-size</code> | Icon size. |
| <code>--icon-target-size</code> | Icon tap target size. |
| <code>--leading-space</code> | Space before the leading icon. |
| <code>--max-height</code> | Docked maximum height. |
| <code>--max-width</code> | Docked maximum width. |
| <code>--min-height</code> | Docked minimum height. |
| <code>--min-width</code> | Docked minimum width. |
| <code>--results-shape</code> | Contained docked results shape. |
| <code>--scrim-color</code> | Docked scrim color. |
| <code>--trailing-space</code> | Space after the trailing icon. |

# Select

Select menus let people choose one option from a list that opens on a temporary surface.

**Example: A filled select with a label**

```html
<md-gb-select label="Fruit">
  <md-gb-select-option value="apple">Apple</md-gb-select-option>
  <md-gb-select-option value="apricot">Apricot</md-gb-select-option>
  <md-gb-select-option value="banana">Banana</md-gb-select-option>
</md-gb-select>
```

## Usage guidelines

*   **Fixed list of choices.** Use a select to choose one value from a short, fixed list, like the native `<select>`. For a longer list that people can search, use the [autocomplete](#autocomplete).
*   **Pick the variant by emphasis.** Filled selects stand out more; [outlined](#variants) selects are lighter on dense forms.
*   **Say what is wrong.** Pair an [error](#error-and-supporting-text) with text that explains how to fix it.

## Anatomy

A select holds options and a field that shows the chosen one. Options can have icons and extra text.

**Example: A select whose options have icons, supporting text and trailing text**

```html
<md-gb-select label="Delivery">
  <md-gb-icon slot="leading-icon">local_shipping</md-gb-icon>
  <md-gb-select-option value="standard">
    <md-gb-icon slot="leading">schedule</md-gb-icon>
    <span slot="supporting-text">3 to 5 days</span>
    <span slot="trailing-text">Free</span>
    <md-gb-icon slot="trailing">check</md-gb-icon>
    Standard
  </md-gb-select-option>
  <md-gb-select-option value="express">
    <md-gb-icon slot="leading">bolt</md-gb-icon>
    <span slot="supporting-text">Next day</span>
    <span slot="trailing-text">$8</span>
    Express
  </md-gb-select-option>
</md-gb-select>
```

## Examples

### Variants

Selects are `filled` by default. Set `variant="outlined"` for an outlined field.

**Example: An outlined select with a label**

```html
<md-gb-select label="Fruit" variant="outlined">
  <md-gb-select-option value="apple">Apple</md-gb-select-option>
  <md-gb-select-option value="apricot">Apricot</md-gb-select-option>
</md-gb-select>
```

### Selected option

Add `selected` to an option, or set `value` on the select, to choose one at the start.

**Example: A select with Mobile chosen**

```html
<md-gb-select label="Phone type" value="mobile">
  <md-gb-select-option value="home">Home</md-gb-select-option>
  <md-gb-select-option value="mobile">Mobile</md-gb-select-option>
  <md-gb-select-option value="work">Work</md-gb-select-option>
</md-gb-select>
```

### Option content

Options take a `leading` icon, `supporting-text`, `trailing-text` and a `trailing` icon. Disabled options can't be chosen.

**Example: Options with supporting and trailing text, one disabled**

```html
<md-gb-select label="Plan" variant="outlined">
  <md-gb-select-option value="free">
    Free
    <span slot="supporting-text">1 project</span>
    <span slot="trailing-text">$0</span>
  </md-gb-select-option>
  <md-gb-select-option value="pro">
    Pro
    <span slot="supporting-text">Unlimited projects</span>
    <span slot="trailing-text">$8</span>
  </md-gb-select-option>
  <md-gb-select-option value="team" disabled>
    Team
    <span slot="supporting-text">Coming soon</span>
  </md-gb-select-option>
</md-gb-select>
```

### Leading icon

An icon in the `leading-icon` slot sits before the chosen text.

**Example: A select with a leading icon and icons on its options**

```html
<md-gb-select label="Phone type" value="mobile">
  <md-gb-icon slot="leading-icon">phone</md-gb-icon>
  <md-gb-select-option value="business">
    <md-gb-icon slot="leading">business_center</md-gb-icon>
    Business
  </md-gb-select-option>
  <md-gb-select-option value="mobile">
    <md-gb-icon slot="leading">smartphone</md-gb-icon>
    Mobile
  </md-gb-select-option>
</md-gb-select>
```

### Error and supporting text

Use `supporting-text` for a hint. When `error` is set, `error-text` replaces it. Add `required` to mark the field as mandatory.

**Example: A required select in an error state**

```html
<md-gb-select label="Country" required error error-text="Choose a country">
  <md-gb-select-option value="ca">Canada</md-gb-select-option>
  <md-gb-select-option value="mx">Mexico</md-gb-select-option>
</md-gb-select>
```

### Autocomplete

`md-gb-autocomplete` is a text field with the same options, filtered as people type. Set `filter` to change how options match.

**Example: An autocomplete for US states**

```html
<md-gb-autocomplete label="State">
  <md-gb-select-option>Alabama</md-gb-select-option>
  <md-gb-select-option>Alaska</md-gb-select-option>
  <md-gb-select-option>Arizona</md-gb-select-option>
</md-gb-autocomplete>
```

### In a form

A select takes part in a form through its `name` and `value`, and `required` is checked on submit.

**Example: A required select with a submit button**

```html
<form>
  <md-gb-select name="size" label="Size" required>
    <md-gb-select-option value="s">Small</md-gb-select-option>
    <md-gb-select-option value="m">Medium</md-gb-select-option>
    <md-gb-select-option value="l">Large</md-gb-select-option>
  </md-gb-select>
  <md-gb-button type="submit">Order</md-gb-button>
</form>
```

## Accessibility

*   The field is a `combobox` and the menu a `listbox`. The `label` names the field; add an [`aria-label`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Accessibility/ARIA/Attributes/aria-label) when the label is elsewhere.
*   Enter, Space, or the arrow keys open the menu, the arrow keys move between options, and Escape closes it. Typing a few letters jumps to a matching option.

**Example: A select with no visible label, named Sort by**

```html
<md-gb-select aria-label="Sort by" value="new">
  <md-gb-select-option value="new">Newest</md-gb-select-option>
  <md-gb-select-option value="old">Oldest</md-gb-select-option>
</md-gb-select>
```

## API reference

### &lt;md-gb-autocomplete&gt;

A Material Design component.

#### Properties

| Property | Attribute | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <code>error</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Whether the field is in a visually invalid state. Overrides the error state set by <code>reportValidity()</code>.</span> | <code>error</code> | <code>boolean</code> | <code>false</code> |
| <code>errorText</code><br><span class="gb-desc">The message that replaces the supporting text while <code>error</code> is true. Overrides the message shown by <code>reportValidity()</code>.</span> | <code>error-text</code> | <code>string</code> | <code>''</code> |
| <code>filter</code><br><span class="gb-desc">How options are filtered by the typed text: <code>contains</code> (default), <code>starts-with</code>, or <code>none</code> (the page updates the options itself, e.g. from a server, on <code>input</code>).</span> | <code>filter</code> | <code>AutocompleteFilter</code> | <code>'contains'</code> |
| <code>hasLeadingIcon</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Whether a leading icon is slotted. Set it for SSR.</span> | <code>has-leading-icon</code> | <code>boolean</code> | <code>false</code> |
| <code>label</code><br><span class="gb-desc">The floating label; also the field's accessible name.</span> | <code>label</code> | <code>string</code> | <code>''</code> |
| <code>noAsterisk</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Hides the asterisk added to the label of a required field.</span> | <code>no-asterisk</code> | <code>boolean</code> | <code>false</code> |
| <code>open</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Whether the menu is open.</span> | <code>open</code> | <code>boolean</code> | <code>false</code> |
| <code>placeholder</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Hint text shown in the input while it is empty and the label floats.</span> | <code>placeholder</code> | <code>string</code> | <code>''</code> |
| <code>required</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Whether a value is required. Adds an asterisk to the label.</span> | <code>required</code> | <code>boolean</code> | <code>false</code> |
| <code>supportingText</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Additional information shown below the field.</span> | <code>supporting-text</code> | <code>string</code> | <code>''</code> |
| <code>value</code><br><span class="gb-desc">The text in the field.</span> | <code>value</code> | <code>string</code> | <code>''</code> |
| <code>variant</code><br><span class="gb-desc">The variant: <code>filled</code> (default) or <code>outlined</code>.</span> | <code>variant</code> | <code>TextFieldVariant</code> | <code>'filled'</code> |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| default | The <code>md-gb-select-option</code> suggestions. |
| <code>leading-icon</code> | An icon before the input. |
| <code>trailing-icon</code> | Replaces the dropdown arrow icon. |

#### Events

| Event | Description |
| --- | --- |
| <code>change</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Event</span> | The text was committed (picked option or native change). |
| <code>closed</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Event</span> | The menu closed. |
| <code>closing</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Event</span> | The menu is about to close. |
| <code>input</code><br><span class="gb-desc">InputEvent</span> | The text changed by typing or picking an option. |
| <code>invalid</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Event</span> | Fired when <code>checkValidity()</code> or <code>reportValidity()</code> finds the field invalid. |
| <code>opened</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Event</span> | The menu opened. |
| <code>opening</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Event</span> | The menu is about to open. |

#### Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| <code>blur</code><br><span class="gb-desc">() =&gt; void</span> | [MDN Reference](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/HTMLElement/blur) |
| <code>focus</code><br><span class="gb-desc">(options?: FocusOptions) =&gt; void</span> | [MDN Reference](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/HTMLElement/focus) |
| <code>reset</code><br><span class="gb-desc">() =&gt; void</span> | Restores the <code>value</code> attribute and clears native errors. |
| <code>select</code><br><span class="gb-desc">() =&gt; void</span> | Selects all the text. |
| <code>setCustomValidity</code><br><span class="gb-desc">(error: string) =&gt; void</span> | Sets the element's constraint validation error message. When set to a non-empty string, <code>validity.customError</code> will be true and <code>validationMessage</code> will display the provided error. Use this method to customize error messages reported. https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLInputElement/setCustomValidity |
| <code>showPicker</code><br><span class="gb-desc">() =&gt; void</span> | Opens the menu. |

A Material Design component.

#### Properties

| Property | Attribute | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <code>disabled</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Whether the option cannot be selected. It can still become active.</span> | <code>disabled</code> | <code>boolean</code> | <code>false</code> |
| <code>displayText</code><br><span class="gb-desc">The text shown in the field when the option is selected. Defaults to the option's label text.</span> | <code>display-text</code> | <code>string</code> |  |
| <code>selected</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Whether the option is selected. The <code>selected</code> attribute is the default selection restored on form reset.</span> | <code>selected</code> | <code>boolean</code> |  |
| <code>typeaheadText</code><br><span class="gb-desc">The text matched by typeahead and filtering. Defaults to <code>displayText</code>.</span> | <code>typeahead-text</code> | <code>string</code> |  |
| <code>value</code><br><span class="gb-desc">The form value. Defaults to <code>displayText</code>, like a native <code>&lt;option&gt;</code>.</span> | <code>value</code> | <code>string</code> |  |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| default | The option's label. |
| <code>leading</code> | An icon before the label. Without one, a selected option shows a checkmark. |
| <code>supporting-text</code> | Supporting text below the label. |
| <code>trailing</code> | An icon after the label. |
| <code>trailing-text</code> | Metadata after the label, such as a keyboard shortcut. |

#### CSS parts

| Part | Description |
| --- | --- |
| <code>::part(menu-item)</code> | The option's root element. |

# Sliders

Sliders let people view and select a value, or a range of values, along a track.

**Example: A volume slider with a value label**

```html
<md-gb-slider aria-label="Volume" value="50" labeled></md-gb-slider>
```

## Usage guidelines

*   **Show the full range.** A slider should present every value that can be chosen, with `min` and `max` set to match.
*   **Apply the value right away.** Use sliders for settings such as volume or brightness, where people see the effect as they drag.
*   **Pick the variant by the value.** A standard slider fills from the start, a [centered](#centered) slider fills from the middle, and a [range](#range) slider selects two values.

## Anatomy

A slider has a track, a handle, an optional value label and an optional icon.

**Example: A slider with an icon and a value label**

```html
<md-gb-slider aria-label="Volume" value="40" labeled>
  <md-gb-icon slot="icon">volume_up</md-gb-icon>
</md-gb-slider>
```

## Examples

### Stops

Set `step` for a slider that snaps to values, and add `ticks` to show a stop at each one.

**Example: A slider that snaps every 10 with tick marks**

```html
<md-gb-slider aria-label="Brightness" min="0" max="100" step="10" value="50" ticks labeled></md-gb-slider>
```

### Centered

A centered slider starts its active track at the middle of the range, which suits values with a neutral point, such as balance.

**Example: A centered slider from -50 to 50**

```html
<md-gb-slider aria-label="Balance" centered min="-50" max="50" value="0" labeled></md-gb-slider>
```

### Range

Set `range` for two handles. Use `value-start` and `value-end` for the chosen values, and `label-start` and `label-end` to name the handles.

**Example: A price range slider**

```html
<md-gb-slider range min="0" max="100" value-start="25" value-end="75" label-start="Minimum price" label-end="Maximum price" labeled></md-gb-slider>
```

### Icon and size

Put an icon in the `icon` slot to show it inside the track. Sizes run from `xs` (the default) to `xl`.

**Example: A large slider with a volume icon**

```html
<md-gb-slider aria-label="Volume" size="lg" value="60" labeled>
  <md-gb-icon slot="icon">volume_up</md-gb-icon>
</md-gb-slider>
```

### Vertical

Set `orientation="vertical"` for a vertical slider. Range sliders can't be vertical.

**Example: A vertical brightness slider**

```html
<md-gb-slider aria-label="Brightness" orientation="vertical" value="40" labeled></md-gb-slider>
```

### Disabled

A `disabled` slider can't be changed and leaves the focus order.

**Example: A disabled slider**

```html
<md-gb-slider aria-label="Volume" value="30" disabled></md-gb-slider>
```

## Accessibility

*   Name every slider with an [`aria-label`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Accessibility/ARIA/Attributes/aria-label) or a visible label. A range slider names each handle with `label-start` and `label-end`.
*   The handle is a `slider` that exposes its minimum, maximum and value. Set `value-label` (or `value-label-start` and `value-label-end`) when the number alone is unclear: the text is shown on the label and read out, such as "5 minutes".
*   Arrow keys change the value by one step, Page Up and Page Down by a larger amount, and Home and End jump to the ends.

**Example: A slider whose value label reads 5 minutes**

```html
<md-gb-slider aria-label="Timer" min="1" max="60" value="5" value-label="5 minutes" labeled></md-gb-slider>
```

## API reference

### &lt;md-gb-slider&gt;

A Material Design slider component.

#### Properties

| Property | Attribute | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <code>ariaLabelEnd</code> | <code>label-end</code> | <code>string</code> | <code>''</code> |

| <code>ariaValueTextEnd</code> | <code>valuetext-end</code> | <code>string</code> | <code>''</code> |

# Snackbar

Snackbars tell people about a process an app has performed or will perform, without interrupting them.

**Example: A button that shows a snackbar with an Undo action**

*HTML*

```html
<md-gb-button id="archive">Archive</md-gb-button>
<md-gb-snackbar id="archived" fixed label-text="Email archived" action-label="Undo"></md-gb-snackbar>
```

*TypeScript*

```ts
document.querySelector('#archive')!.addEventListener('click', () => {
  document.querySelector('md-gb-snackbar')!.show();
});
```

## Usage guidelines

*   **Low priority only.** Use a snackbar for a message that needs no response. For an important one that blocks the task, use a dialog.
*   **One at a time.** Show a single snackbar, and queue [consecutive](#consecutive-snackbars) messages.
*   **At most one action.** Give it a short action such as Undo. A snackbar with an action stays until it is used or dismissed.
*   **Repeat the message nearby.** A snackbar that disappears on its own is easy to miss, so also show the result inline, such as changing "Save" to "Saved".

## Anatomy

A snackbar has a message, an optional action and an optional close button.

**Example: A snackbar with a message, an action and a close button**

```html
<md-gb-snackbar open timeout-ms="-1">
  Photo deleted
  <md-gb-button slot="action">Undo</md-gb-button>
  <md-gb-icon-button slot="dismiss" aria-label="Close">
    <md-gb-icon>close</md-gb-icon>
  </md-gb-icon-button>
</md-gb-snackbar>
```

## Examples

### Close button

Add `has-close-button` so people can dismiss the snackbar. Without an action it stays for `timeout-ms` (5 seconds by default); use `-1` to keep it open.

**Example: A snackbar with a close button that stays open**

*HTML*

```html
<md-gb-button id="save">Save</md-gb-button>
<md-gb-snackbar id="saved" fixed has-close-button timeout-ms="-1" label-text="Changes saved"></md-gb-snackbar>
```

*TypeScript*

```ts
document.querySelector('#save')!.addEventListener('click', () => {
  document.querySelector('md-gb-snackbar')!.show();
});
```

### Two lines

Put longer text in the default slot for a two-line snackbar.

**Example: A two-line snackbar**

*HTML*

```html
<md-gb-button id="send">Send</md-gb-button>
<md-gb-snackbar id="sent" fixed action-label="View">
  Message sent to 3 people.<br>Replies appear in your inbox.
</md-gb-snackbar>
```

*TypeScript*

```ts
document.querySelector('#send')!.addEventListener('click', () => {
  document.querySelector('md-gb-snackbar')!.show();
});
```

### Consecutive snackbars

`md-gb-snackbar-host` shows messages one after another. Call `showSnackbar()`; it resolves with `action-performed` or `dismissed`. Pass `replace: true` to swap out a message that is out of date.

**Example: A host that queues two messages and reports the result**

*HTML*

```html
<md-gb-button id="queue">Queue messages</md-gb-button>
<output id="result" role="status"></output>
<md-gb-snackbar-host id="host" fixed></md-gb-snackbar-host>
```

*TypeScript*

```ts
const host = document.querySelector('md-gb-snackbar-host')!;
const result = document.querySelector('#result')!;
document.querySelector('#queue')!.addEventListener('click', async () => {
  host.showSnackbar('Photo uploaded');
  const outcome = await host.showSnackbar({message: 'Photo deleted', actionLabel: 'Undo'});
  result.textContent = outcome === 'action-performed' ? 'Restored' : 'Deleted';
});
```

### Anchor

Set `anchor` to the id of an element, such as a FAB, so the snackbar appears above it.

**Example: A snackbar anchored above a FAB**

*HTML*

```html
<md-gb-fab id="compose" aria-label="Compose">
  <md-gb-icon>edit</md-gb-icon>
</md-gb-fab>
<md-gb-snackbar id="drafted" fixed anchor="compose" label-text="Draft saved"></md-gb-snackbar>
```

*TypeScript*

```ts
document.querySelector('#compose')!.addEventListener('click', () => {
  document.querySelector('md-gb-snackbar')!.show();
});
```

## Accessibility

*   The message is announced politely in a live region, so focus stays where it is.
*   Auto-dismissing snackbars are hard to read for people with low vision or who need more time. Give the same information inline, or add an action so the snackbar stays until it is used.
*   Give a snackbar that has a close button a localized `close-label`.
*   Escape closes the snackbar, and a slotted action is a normal button in the tab order.

## API reference

### &lt;md-gb-snackbar&gt;

A Material Design snackbar component.

#### Properties

| Property | Attribute | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <code>actionLabel</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Visible text of the built-in action button. Rendered only when non-empty and nothing is slotted into <code>action</code>.</span> | <code>action-label</code> | <code>string</code> | <code>''</code> |
| <code>align</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Where a snackbar sits on wide layouts: <code>center</code> (default) or <code>start</code> (left-aligned). Use the same value wherever snackbars appear, so they always show in the same spot. Compact layouts span the width.</span> | <code>align</code> | <code>"start" | "center"</code> | <code>'center'</code> |
| <code>anchor</code><br><span class="gb-desc">The id of an element the snackbar appears above, such as a FAB or a docked toolbar, in the snackbar's root (document or shadow root). See <code>anchorElement</code>.</span> | <code>anchor</code> | <code>string</code> | <code>''</code> |
| <code>anchorElement</code><br><span class="gb-desc">An element the snackbar appears above, such as a FAB or a docked toolbar: while open, the snackbar's bottom edge sits <code>--bottom-offset</code> above the element's top edge. Takes precedence over <code>anchor</code>.</span> |  | <code>HTMLElement</code> | <code>null</code> |
| <code>closeLabel</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Accessible label for the built-in dismiss button.</span> | <code>close-label</code> | <code>string</code> | <code>'Close'</code> |
| <code>fixed</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Whether the snackbar should be positioned relative to the viewport (fixed).</span> | <code>fixed</code> | <code>boolean</code> | <code>false</code> |
| <code>hasCloseButton</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Whether to display a close icon button.</span> | <code>has-close-button</code> | <code>boolean</code> | <code>false</code> |
| <code>labelText</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Supporting message text to display. Rendered before default slot content.</span> | <code>label-text</code> | <code>string</code> | <code>''</code> |
| <code>open</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Whether the snackbar is currently open.</span> | <code>open</code> | <code>boolean</code> |  |
| <code>quick</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Whether to skip opening and closing transition delays.</span> | <code>quick</code> | <code>boolean</code> | <code>false</code> |
| <code>timeoutMs</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Time in milliseconds before the snackbar automatically dismisses. Set to 0 or a negative value (e.g. -1) to disable auto-dismiss. Read when the snackbar opens; changing it while open takes effect on the next open.</span> | <code>timeout-ms</code> | <code>number</code> | <code>5000</code> |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| default | Default slot for rich content (rendered after <code>label-text</code>). If both <code>label-text</code> and slotted content are provided, both render. |
| <code>action</code> | Slot for a custom action button; replaces the built-in action rendered from <code>action-label</code>. Prefer the <code>action-label</code> attribute, which renders a text button matching the spec. A slotted plain <code>&lt;button&gt;</code> is styled by the snackbar, with hover, focus and pressed states. A slotted text <code>&lt;md-gb-button&gt;</code> gets the <code>--action-label-text*</code> colors and typography, but keeps its own 16px padding and pressed shape, because its component tokens can't be set from outside its shadow root. |
| <code>dismiss</code> | Slot for dismiss button (falls back to close icon button when <code>has-close-button</code> is set). |

#### Events

| Event | Description |
| --- | --- |
| <code>close</code><br><span class="gb-desc">CustomEvent&lt;&#123;reason: string&#125;&gt;</span> | Fired when the snackbar begins closing. |
| <code>closed</code><br><span class="gb-desc">CustomEvent&lt;&#123;reason: string&#125;&gt;</span> | Fired when the snackbar has closed. |
| <code>open</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Event</span> | Fired when the snackbar begins opening. |
| <code>opened</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Event</span> | Fired when the snackbar has opened and animations finished. |

#### Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| <code>close</code><br><span class="gb-desc">(reason?: string) =&gt; Promise&lt;void&gt;</span> | Closes the snackbar. |
| <code>render</code><br><span class="gb-desc">() =&gt; TemplateResult&lt;1&gt;</span> | Invoked on each update to perform rendering tasks. This method may return any value renderable by lit-html's <code>ChildPart</code> - typically a <code>TemplateResult</code>. Setting properties inside this method will *not* trigger the element to update. |
| <code>show</code><br><span class="gb-desc">() =&gt; Promise&lt;void&gt;</span> | Opens the snackbar. |
| <code>updateAnchorPosition</code><br><span class="gb-desc">() =&gt; void</span> | Places the snackbar above its anchor. Called while open when the window or the anchor resizes; call it after moving the anchor. |

#### CSS parts

| Part | Description |
| --- | --- |
| <code>::part(actions)</code> | The container wrapping action and dismiss slots. |
| <code>::part(label)</code> | The container wrapping the label content. |
| <code>::part(surface)</code> | The surface container of the snackbar. |

#### CSS custom properties

| Property | Description |
| --- | --- |
| <code>--action-label-text</code> | Action button label typography. |
| <code>--action-label-text-axes</code> | Action button label typography font variation settings. |
| <code>--action-label-text-color</code> | Action button label text color. |
| <code>--action-label-text-tracking</code> | Action button label letter spacing. |
| <code>--bottom-offset</code> | Inset block end distance from container bottom, or from the top of the <code>anchor</code>. |
| <code>--container-color</code> | Container background color. |
| <code>--container-elevation</code> | Container box shadow elevation. |
| <code>--container-shape</code> | Container border radius. |
| <code>--icon-color</code> | Close icon color. |
| <code>--icon-size</code> | Close icon size. |
| <code>--max-width</code> | Maximum surface width in wide layout. |
| <code>--min-height</code> | Minimum surface height (the single-line height). |
| <code>--min-width</code> | Minimum surface width in wide layout. |
| <code>--position</code> | CSS position property (<code>absolute</code> by default). |
| <code>--supporting-text</code> | Supporting label typography. |
| <code>--supporting-text-axes</code> | Supporting label typography font variation settings. |
| <code>--supporting-text-color</code> | Supporting label text color. |
| <code>--supporting-text-tracking</code> | Supporting label letter spacing. |
| <code>--with-single-line-container-height</code> | Single-line container height (spec 48dp). |
| <code>--with-two-lines-container-height</code> | Two-line container height (spec 68dp). |
| <code>--z-index</code> | Z-index of the snackbar. |

### &lt;md-gb-snackbar-host&gt;

Shows queued snackbars one at a time.

#### Properties

| Property | Attribute | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <code>anchor</code><br><span class="gb-desc">The id of the element the built-in snackbar appears above, such as a FAB (see <code>md-gb-snackbar</code> <code>anchor</code>).</span> | <code>anchor</code> | <code>string</code> | <code>''</code> |
| <code>anchorElement</code><br><span class="gb-desc">The element the built-in snackbar appears above, such as a FAB.</span> |  | <code>HTMLElement</code> | <code>null</code> |
| <code>closeLabel</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Accessible label of the close icon button.</span> | <code>close-label</code> | <code>string</code> | <code>'Close'</code> |
| <code>fixed</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Whether the built-in snackbar is positioned in the viewport (fixed).</span> | <code>fixed</code> | <code>boolean</code> | <code>false</code> |
| <code>quick</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Whether to skip the snackbar's opening and closing motion.</span> | <code>quick</code> | <code>boolean</code> | <code>false</code> |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| default | Optional <code>md-gb-snackbar</code> to show the messages in. |

#### Events

| Event | Description |
| --- | --- |
| <code>close</code><br><span class="gb-desc">CustomEvent&lt;&#123;reason: string&#125;&gt;</span> | Bubbles from the snackbar when it begins closing. |
| <code>closed</code><br><span class="gb-desc">CustomEvent&lt;&#123;reason: string&#125;&gt;</span> | Bubbles from the snackbar when it has closed. |

#### Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| <code>dismissAll</code><br><span class="gb-desc">() =&gt; void</span> | Dismisses the current snackbar and every queued one. |
| <code>render</code><br><span class="gb-desc">() =&gt; TemplateResult&lt;1&gt;</span> | Invoked on each update to perform rendering tasks. This method may return any value renderable by lit-html's <code>ChildPart</code> - typically a <code>TemplateResult</code>. Setting properties inside this method will *not* trigger the element to update. |
| <code>showSnackbar</code><br><span class="gb-desc">(options: string | ShowSnackbarOptions) =&gt; Promise&lt;SnackbarResult&gt;</span> | Queues a snackbar and resolves when it ends: <code>action-performed</code> when its action is activated, otherwise <code>dismissed</code>. |

#### CSS parts

| Part | Description |
| --- | --- |
| <code>::part(snackbar)</code> | The built-in snackbar, when none is slotted. |

# Switch

Switches toggle the state of an item on or off.

**Example: A switch with a text label**

```html
<label>
  Wi-Fi
  <md-gb-switch selected></md-gb-switch>
</label>
```

## Usage guidelines

*   **Use for settings.** Switches are the best way to let people adjust a setting. Use a switch, not a radio button, when each item in a list is controlled on its own.
*   **Visible at a glance.** Make the on or off state clear, and let the change take effect right away.
*   **Label with text.** Put the label next to the switch in a `<label>`. Its text color stays the same, even when the switch changes.

## Anatomy

A switch has a track, a handle and optional icons shown in the handle.

**Example: A switch with an icon in the handle for each state**

```html
<md-gb-switch aria-label="Airplane mode" selected>
  <md-gb-icon slot="off-icon">close</md-gb-icon>
  <md-gb-icon slot="on-icon">check</md-gb-icon>
</md-gb-switch>
```

## Examples

### Selected

Add `selected` to start with the switch on.

**Example: A label wrapping a selected switch, and a label linked by for**

```html
<label>
  Wi-Fi
  <md-gb-switch selected></md-gb-switch>
</label>
<label for="bluetooth">Bluetooth</label>
<md-gb-switch id="bluetooth"></md-gb-switch>
```

### Icons

Icons in the `on-icon` and `off-icon` slots appear in the handle. Fill only `on-icon` to show an icon just when the switch is on.

**Example: A switch with a check mark when on and a close mark when off**

```html
<md-gb-switch aria-label="Notifications">
  <md-gb-icon slot="on-icon">check</md-gb-icon>
  <md-gb-icon slot="off-icon">close</md-gb-icon>
</md-gb-switch>
```

**Example: A switch with an icon only when on**

```html
<md-gb-switch aria-label="Dark mode" selected>
  <md-gb-icon slot="on-icon">check</md-gb-icon>
</md-gb-switch>
```

### Disabled

A `disabled` switch can't be changed.

**Example: A disabled switch that is off and one that is on**

```html
<md-gb-switch aria-label="Sync off" disabled></md-gb-switch>
<md-gb-switch aria-label="Sync on" disabled selected></md-gb-switch>
```

### In a form

A switch submits its `value` (`on` by default) under its `name` when it is selected, and `required` means it must be on.

**Example: A required switch that accepts the terms**

```html
<form>
  <label>
    Accept terms
    <md-gb-switch name="terms" required></md-gb-switch>
  </label>
  <md-gb-button type="submit">Continue</md-gb-button>
</form>
```

## Accessibility

*   A switch has the `switch` role. It takes its name from an adjacent `<label>`, or from an explicit [`aria-label`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Accessibility/ARIA/Attributes/aria-label), which wins over the label.
*   Add an `aria-label` to a switch with no visible label.
*   Space toggles the switch.

**Example: A switch with no visible label, named Lights**

```html
<md-gb-switch aria-label="Lights"></md-gb-switch>
```

## API reference

### &lt;md-gb-switch&gt;

A Material Design component.

#### Properties

| Property | Attribute | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <code>density</code><br><span class="gb-desc">The density, from 0 (default) to -3. Each step down removes 4px from the state layer (40px); the track keeps its size and the touch target stays 48px. Values are clamped to that range. switch.md: don't apply density by default; let people opt in to a denser layout.</span> | <code>density</code> | <code>Density</code> |  |
| <code>required</code><br><span class="gb-desc">When true, require the switch to be selected when participating in form submission. https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/input/checkbox#validation</span> | <code>required</code> | <code>boolean</code> | <code>false</code> |
| <code>selected</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Puts the switch in the selected state and sets the form submission value to the <code>value</code> property.</span> | <code>selected</code> | <code>boolean</code> |  |
| <code>value</code><br><span class="gb-desc">The value associated with this switch on form submission. <code>null</code> is submitted when <code>selected</code> is <code>false</code>.</span> | <code>value</code> | <code>string</code> | <code>'on'</code> |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| <code>off-icon</code> | Used to show an icon when the switch is unselected. |
| <code>on-icon</code> | Used to show an icon when the switch is selected. |

#### Events

| Event | Description |
| --- | --- |
| <code>change</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Event</span> | Fired when the switch is selected or unselected. |
| <code>input</code><br><span class="gb-desc">InputEvent</span> | Fired when the switch is selected or unselected. |

#### CSS parts

| Part | Description |
| --- | --- |
| <code>::part(switch)</code> | The switch's root element. |

#### CSS custom properties

| Property | Description |
| --- | --- |
| <code>--density-step</code> | State layer size removed per density step. |
| <code>--handle-color</code> |  |
| <code>--handle-height</code> |  |
| <code>--handle-shape</code> |  |
| <code>--handle-width</code> |  |
| <code>--icon-color</code> |  |
| <code>--icon-size</code> |  |
| <code>--state-layer-color</code> |  |
| <code>--state-layer-shape</code> |  |
| <code>--state-layer-size</code> | State layer size at density 0. |
| <code>--target-size</code> | The minimum touch target size, kept at any density. |
| <code>--track-color</code> |  |
| <code>--track-height</code> |  |
| <code>--track-opacity</code> |  |
| <code>--track-outline-color</code> |  |
| <code>--track-outline-width</code> |  |
| <code>--track-shape</code> |  |
| <code>--track-width</code> |  |
| <code>--with-icon-handle-height</code> |  |
| <code>--with-icon-handle-width</code> |  |

Source: https://material-web.dev/3.0/components/tabs/

# Tabs

Tabs organize groups of related content that are at the same level of hierarchy.

**Example: Primary tabs with Flights selected**

```html
<md-gb-tabs aria-label="Travel">
  <md-gb-tab selected><span slot="label">Flights</span></md-gb-tab>
  <md-gb-tab><span slot="label">Trips</span></md-gb-tab>
  <md-gb-tab><span slot="label">Explore</span></md-gb-tab>
</md-gb-tabs>
```

## Usage guidelines

*   **Same level of hierarchy.** Tabs switch between views of related content that are peers. Don't use them for steps in a flow.
*   **Primary or secondary.** [Primary](#primary-and-secondary) tabs sit at the top of the content under a top app bar and show the main destinations. [Secondary](#primary-and-secondary) tabs split a content area further. Use one type in a bar.
*   **Short labels.** Keep labels to a word or two. Use [icons](#icons) only when they are simple and recognizable.
*   **Avoid dense tabs by default.** Lowering the [density](#density) shrinks the targets below 48px, so let people opt in.

## Anatomy

A tab list holds tabs, and each tab has an optional icon, a label and an optional badge. Tab panels hold the content.

**Example: Tabs with an icon, label and badge, and their panels**

```html
<md-gb-tabs id="anatomy-tabs" aria-label="Mail">
  <md-gb-tab selected>
    <md-gb-icon>inbox</md-gb-icon>
    <span slot="label">Inbox</span>
    <span class="badge badge-large tab-badge" slot="badge">3</span>
  </md-gb-tab>
  <md-gb-tab>
    <md-gb-icon>send</md-gb-icon>
    <span slot="label">Sent</span>
  </md-gb-tab>
</md-gb-tabs>
<md-gb-tab-panels for="anatomy-tabs">
  <div role="tabpanel">Three new messages.</div>
  <div role="tabpanel">Messages you sent.</div>
</md-gb-tab-panels>
```

## Examples

### Primary and secondary

Tabs are `primary` by default. Set `variant="secondary"` for secondary tabs, which put the icon beside the label.

**Example: Secondary tabs with icons**

```html
<md-gb-tabs variant="secondary" aria-label="Trip type">
  <md-gb-tab selected>
    <md-gb-icon>flight</md-gb-icon>
    <span slot="label">Travel</span>
  </md-gb-tab>
  <md-gb-tab>
    <md-gb-icon>hotel</md-gb-icon>
    <span slot="label">Hotel</span>
  </md-gb-tab>
</md-gb-tabs>
```

### Icons

Put an icon before the label, or leave out the label for icon-only tabs. Icon-only tabs need an `aria-label`.

**Example: Tabs with icons and labels, and icon-only tabs**

```html
<md-gb-tabs aria-label="Travel">
  <md-gb-tab selected>
    <md-gb-icon>flight</md-gb-icon>
    <span slot="label">Flights</span>
  </md-gb-tab>
  <md-gb-tab>
    <md-gb-icon>luggage</md-gb-icon>
    <span slot="label">Trips</span>
  </md-gb-tab>
</md-gb-tabs>
<md-gb-tabs aria-label="Media">
  <md-gb-tab selected aria-label="Photos"><md-gb-icon>photo</md-gb-icon></md-gb-tab>
  <md-gb-tab aria-label="Videos"><md-gb-icon>videocam</md-gb-icon></md-gb-tab>
</md-gb-tabs>
```

### Badges

A tab can show a badge in the `badge` slot for counts or status.

**Example: Tabs with a count badge**

```html
<md-gb-tabs aria-label="Mail">
  <md-gb-tab selected>
    <span slot="label">Inbox</span>
    <span class="badge badge-large tab-badge" slot="badge">3</span>
  </md-gb-tab>
  <md-gb-tab><span slot="label">Sent</span></md-gb-tab>
</md-gb-tabs>
```

### Tab panels

Link each tab to its panel with `tabpanel`, the id of a panel such as `md-aria-tabpanel`. Only the selected panel is shown.

**Example: Tabs linked to two panels**

```html
<md-gb-tabs aria-label="Travel">
  <md-gb-tab selected tabpanel="flights-panel"><span slot="label">Flights</span></md-gb-tab>
  <md-gb-tab tabpanel="trips-panel"><span slot="label">Trips</span></md-gb-tab>
</md-gb-tabs>
<md-aria-tabpanel id="flights-panel">Search one-way and round-trip fares.</md-aria-tabpanel>
<md-aria-tabpanel id="trips-panel">Your upcoming and past bookings.</md-aria-tabpanel>
```

### Swipeable panels

`md-gb-tab-panels` holds the panels next to the tabs and lets people swipe between them. It pairs with the previous tab list, or with `for`, the id of one. Set `gestures-disabled` to turn swiping off.

**Example: Tabs and swipeable panels**

```html
<md-gb-tabs id="places" aria-label="Places">
  <md-gb-tab selected><span slot="label">Flights</span></md-gb-tab>
  <md-gb-tab><span slot="label">Trips</span></md-gb-tab>
  <md-gb-tab><span slot="label">Explore</span></md-gb-tab>
</md-gb-tabs>
<md-gb-tab-panels for="places">
  <div role="tabpanel">Search one-way and round-trip fares.</div>
  <div role="tabpanel">Your upcoming and past bookings.</div>
  <div role="tabpanel">Ideas for your next destination.</div>
</md-gb-tab-panels>
```

### Scrollable

Fixed tabs share the width equally. Set `scrollable` to size each tab to its label and scroll the bar when they overflow.

**Example: Scrollable tabs with many labels**

```html
<md-gb-tabs scrollable aria-label="Travel">
  <md-gb-tab selected><span slot="label">Flights</span></md-gb-tab>
  <md-gb-tab><span slot="label">Trips</span></md-gb-tab>
  <md-gb-tab><span slot="label">Hotels</span></md-gb-tab>
  <md-gb-tab><span slot="label">Car rental</span></md-gb-tab>
  <md-gb-tab><span slot="label">Things to do</span></md-gb-tab>
</md-gb-tabs>
```

### Density

Set `density` from 0 (default) to -3 to remove 4px of height per step.

**Example: Tabs with a density of -2**

```html
<md-gb-tabs density="-2" aria-label="Travel">
  <md-gb-tab selected><span slot="label">Flights</span></md-gb-tab>
  <md-gb-tab><span slot="label">Trips</span></md-gb-tab>
</md-gb-tabs>
```

### Selection events

The tab list fires `change` when a person picks a tab. Read the new tab from `selectedTabIndex`.

**Example: Tabs that print the index of the selected tab**

*HTML*

```html
<md-gb-tabs aria-label="Travel">
  <md-gb-tab selected><span slot="label">Flights</span></md-gb-tab>
  <md-gb-tab><span slot="label">Trips</span></md-gb-tab>
  <md-gb-tab><span slot="label">Explore</span></md-gb-tab>
</md-gb-tabs>
<output>Selected tab: 0</output>
```

*JavaScript*

```js
const tabs = document.querySelector('md-gb-tabs');
const output = document.querySelector('output');
tabs.addEventListener('change', () => {
  output.textContent = `Selected tab: ${tabs.selectedTabIndex}`;
});
```

## Accessibility

*   Tabs use the `tablist`, `tab` and `tabpanel` roles. Label the tab list with [`aria-label`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Accessibility/ARIA/Attributes/aria-label) or [`aria-labelledby`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Accessibility/ARIA/Attributes/aria-labelledby), and give icon-only tabs an `aria-label`.
*   The list is one tab stop. The arrow keys move between tabs, and Space or Enter selects the focused one.
*   Each tab controls a panel, and each panel is labelled by its tab. Linking them with `tabpanel` or `md-gb-tab-panels` does this for you.

## API reference

### &lt;md-gb-tab&gt;

A Material Design tab component.

#### Properties

| Property | Attribute | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <code>selected</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Whether the tab is selected.</span> | <code>selected</code> | <code>boolean</code> |  |
| <code>tabpanel</code><br><span class="gb-desc">ID of the associated <code>md-aria-tabpanel</code> element.</span> | <code>tabpanel</code> | <code>string</code> |  |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| default | Used to display an optional leading icon, such as <code>&lt;md-gb-icon&gt;</code>. Icons are unclassed; the tab sets <code>--md-icon-*</code> for them. |
| <code>badge</code> | Used to display an optional badge, such as <code>&lt;span class="badge tab-badge"&gt;</code>. |
| <code>label</code> | Used to display the tab's label. <code>&lt;span class="tab-label"&gt;</code> in the default slot is equivalent. Bare text is not supported. |

| --- | --- |

| <code>--focus-indicator-inset</code> |  |
| <code>--focus-indicator-shape</code> |  |
| <code>--icon-badge-inset</code> |  |
| <code>--icon-color</code> |  |
| <code>--icon-label-space</code> |  |
| <code>--icon-size</code> |  |
| <code>--label-text</code> |  |
| <code>--label-text-axes</code> |  |
| <code>--label-text-color</code> |  |
| <code>--label-text-tracking</code> |  |
| <code>--leading-space</code> |  |
| <code>--stacked-icon-label-space</code> |  |
| <code>--tab-scroll-margin</code> |  |
| <code>--trailing-space</code> |  |

### &lt;md-gb-tab-panels&gt;

The swipeable content panels of a set of Material Design tabs.

#### Properties

| Property | Attribute | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |

#### CSS custom properties

| Property | Description |
| --- | --- |
| <code>--transition-duration</code> | Duration of a slide between panels. |
| <code>--transition-easing</code> | Easing of a slide between panels. |

### &lt;md-gb-tabs&gt;

A Material Design tabs component.

#### Properties

| Property | Attribute | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

At compact windows the tabs fill the full width.</span> | <code>align</code> | <code>"start" | "center"</code> | <code>'center'</code> |
