# Text field

Text fields let people enter and edit text.

**Example: A filled text field with a label**

```html
<md-gb-text-field label="Name"></md-gb-text-field>
```

## Usage guidelines

*   **Filled or outlined.** Filled fields have more visual weight and suit most forms. [Outlined](#variants) fields are lighter and work where many fields sit together. Don't mix them in one form.
*   **Label every field.** The label floats above the text once the field has a value or focus. Use a [placeholder](#variants) only as an example of the input, never in place of the label.
*   **Help before and after.** Use [supporting text](#supporting-text-and-counter) for hints, and explain what went wrong in an [error](#error-and-validation).

## Anatomy

A text field has a label, the input, optional icons and prefix or suffix text, and supporting text.

**Example: A field with a label, icons, prefix, suffix and supporting text**

```html
<md-gb-text-field label="Website" prefix-text="https://" suffix-text=".com" supporting-text="Your public address">
  <md-gb-icon slot="leading-icon">language</md-gb-icon>
  <md-gb-icon slot="trailing-icon">link</md-gb-icon>
</md-gb-text-field>
```

## Examples

### Variants

Text fields are `filled` by default. Set `variant="outlined"` for an outlined field. Add `placeholder` for an example of the input.

**Example: An outlined text field with a placeholder**

```html
<md-gb-text-field label="Email" variant="outlined" placeholder="name@example.com"></md-gb-text-field>
```

### Input types

`type` changes the keyboard and the built-in validation. It can be `text` (default), `email`, `number`, `password`, `search`, `tel`, `url` or `textarea`.

**Example: Password, email and number fields**

```html
<md-gb-text-field type="password" label="Password"></md-gb-text-field>
<md-gb-text-field type="email" label="Email"></md-gb-text-field>
<md-gb-text-field type="number" label="Quantity" min="1" max="10"></md-gb-text-field>
```

### Textarea

`type="textarea"` makes a multi-line field. Set `rows` for its height.

**Example: A three-row textarea**

```html
<md-gb-text-field type="textarea" label="Message" rows="3"></md-gb-text-field>
```

### Icons

Icons in the `leading-icon` and `trailing-icon` slots sit before and after the input. A trailing icon button needs an `aria-label`.

**Example: A search field with a leading icon and a clear button**

```html
<md-gb-text-field label="Search" value="Pasta">
  <md-gb-icon slot="leading-icon">search</md-gb-icon>
  <md-gb-icon-button slot="trailing-icon" aria-label="Clear">
    <md-gb-icon>cancel</md-gb-icon>
  </md-gb-icon-button>
</md-gb-text-field>
```

### Prefix and suffix

`prefix-text` and `suffix-text` show fixed text around the input, such as a currency or a domain.

**Example: Fields with a prefix and a suffix**

```html
<md-gb-text-field label="Amount" prefix-text="$" value="100"></md-gb-text-field>
<md-gb-text-field label="Email" suffix-text="@example.com" value="ada"></md-gb-text-field>
```

### Supporting text and counter

`supporting-text` shows a hint below the field. A `maxlength` adds a character counter.

**Example: A field with a hint and a 20 character limit**

```html
<md-gb-text-field label="Bio" maxlength="20" value="Hello" supporting-text="Tell us about yourself"></md-gb-text-field>
```

### Error and validation

Set `error` and `error-text` to show an error yourself. A field also validates with the browser's constraint attributes (`required`, `pattern`, `minlength`, `min`, `max`) when its form is submitted or `reportValidity()` is called, and shows the message in its supporting text.

**Example: A field in an error state**

```html
<md-gb-text-field label="ZIP code" value="1234" error error-text="Enter a 5-digit ZIP code"></md-gb-text-field>
```

### Required

`required` adds an asterisk to the label and makes an empty field invalid. Add `no-asterisk` to hide it.

**Example: A required field**

```html
<md-gb-text-field label="Username" required supporting-text="Required"></md-gb-text-field>
```

### Disabled and read-only

A `disabled` field can't be focused. A `readonly` field can be focused and selected but not edited.

**Example: A disabled field and a read-only field**

```html
<md-gb-text-field label="Account" value="Locked" disabled></md-gb-text-field>
<md-gb-text-field label="Order number" value="A-1042" readonly></md-gb-text-field>
```

### In a form

Fields take part in a form through their `name` and `value`, and the form checks them on submit.

**Example: A form with a required name and an email field**

```html
<form>
  <md-gb-text-field name="name" label="Name" required></md-gb-text-field>
  <md-gb-text-field name="email" type="email" label="Email" required></md-gb-text-field>
  <md-gb-button type="submit">Subscribe</md-gb-button>
</form>
```

### Density

Set `density` from 0 (default) to -3 to remove 4px of height per step.

**Example: A field with a density of -2**

```html
<md-gb-text-field label="Name" density="-2"></md-gb-text-field>
```

## Accessibility

*   The field's `label` names the input. For a field with an external label, add an [`aria-label`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Accessibility/ARIA/Attributes/aria-label).
*   Supporting and error text are linked to the input, so screen readers read them with it. An invalid field is marked with `aria-invalid`.
*   Icon buttons in a slot need their own `aria-label`.

**Example: A field with no visible label, named Search the catalog**

```html
<md-gb-text-field aria-label="Search the catalog" placeholder="Search"></md-gb-text-field>
```

## API reference

### &lt;md-gb-text-field&gt;

A Material Design text field (filled or outlined).

#### Properties

| Property | Attribute | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <code>autocomplete</code><br><span class="gb-desc">The input's <code>autocomplete</code> hint.</span> | <code>autocomplete</code> | <code>string</code> | <code>''</code> |
| <code>cols</code><br><span class="gb-desc">The number of columns of a <code>type="textarea"</code> field.</span> | <code>cols</code> | <code>number</code> | <code>20</code> |
| <code>density</code><br><span class="gb-desc">The density, from 0 (default) to -3. Each step down removes 4px from the container height (56px), half above and half below the content; text keeps its size. Values are clamped to that range. text-fields.md "Avoid applying density by default": dense fields are below the 48x48 CSS pixel target, so let people opt in (a denser layout or theme) and keep the controls that change it at 48x48.</span> | <code>density</code> | <code>Density</code> |  |
| <code>error</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Whether the field is in a visually invalid state. Overrides the error state set by <code>reportValidity()</code>.</span> | <code>error</code> | <code>boolean</code> | <code>false</code> |
| <code>errorIcon</code><br><span class="gb-desc">When the error icon shows in the trailing edge: <code>always</code> (default) in the error state, or <code>focus</code> only while the field has focus. Its space stays reserved, so focusing the field does not move the text.</span> | <code>error-icon</code> | <code>ErrorIconVisibility</code> | <code>'always'</code> |
| <code>errorText</code><br><span class="gb-desc">The message that replaces the supporting text while <code>error</code> is true. If empty, the supporting text keeps showing. Overrides the message shown by <code>reportValidity()</code>.</span> | <code>error-text</code> | <code>string</code> | <code>''</code> |
| <code>hasLeadingIcon</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Whether a leading icon is slotted. Set it for SSR.</span> | <code>has-leading-icon</code> | <code>boolean</code> | <code>false</code> |
| <code>hasTrailingIcon</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Whether a trailing icon is slotted. Set it for SSR.</span> | <code>has-trailing-icon</code> | <code>boolean</code> | <code>false</code> |
| <code>inputMode</code><br><span class="gb-desc">[MDN Reference](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/HTMLElement/inputMode)</span> | <code>inputmode</code> | <code>string</code> | <code>''</code> |
| <code>label</code><br><span class="gb-desc">The floating label. It is also the input's accessible name, unless <code>aria-label</code> is set.</span> | <code>label</code> | <code>string</code> | <code>''</code> |
| <code>max</code><br><span class="gb-desc">The greatest permitted value.</span> | <code>max</code> | <code>string</code> | <code>''</code> |
| <code>maxLength</code><br><span class="gb-desc">The maximum number of characters; shows a character counter. -1 for none.</span> | <code>maxlength</code> | <code>number</code> | <code>-1</code> |
| <code>min</code><br><span class="gb-desc">The least permitted value.</span> | <code>min</code> | <code>string</code> | <code>''</code> |
| <code>minLength</code><br><span class="gb-desc">The minimum number of characters. -1 for none.</span> | <code>minlength</code> | <code>number</code> | <code>-1</code> |
| <code>multiple</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Whether an email field accepts multiple addresses.</span> | <code>multiple</code> | <code>boolean</code> | <code>false</code> |
| <code>noAsterisk</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Hides the asterisk added to the label of a required field.</span> | <code>no-asterisk</code> | <code>boolean</code> | <code>false</code> |
| <code>noSpinner</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Hides the spinner of <code>type="number"</code> fields.</span> | <code>no-spinner</code> | <code>boolean</code> | <code>false</code> |
| <code>pattern</code><br><span class="gb-desc">A regular expression the value must match.</span> | <code>pattern</code> | <code>string</code> | <code>''</code> |
| <code>placeholder</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Hint text shown in the input while it is empty and the label is floated (or there is no label).</span> | <code>placeholder</code> | <code>string</code> | <code>''</code> |
| <code>prefixText</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Text shown before the input value, such as a currency symbol.</span> | <code>prefix-text</code> | <code>string</code> | <code>''</code> |
| <code>readOnly</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Whether the value cannot be edited.</span> | <code>readonly</code> | <code>boolean</code> | <code>false</code> |
| <code>required</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Whether a value is required for form submission. Adds an asterisk to the label.</span> | <code>required</code> | <code>boolean</code> | <code>false</code> |
| <code>rows</code><br><span class="gb-desc">The number of rows of a <code>type="textarea"</code> field.</span> | <code>rows</code> | <code>number</code> | <code>2</code> |
| <code>step</code><br><span class="gb-desc">The step between permitted numeric values.</span> | <code>step</code> | <code>string</code> | <code>''</code> |
| <code>suffixText</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Text shown after the input value, such as a unit.</span> | <code>suffix-text</code> | <code>string</code> | <code>''</code> |
| <code>supportingText</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Additional information shown below the field.</span> | <code>supporting-text</code> | <code>string</code> | <code>''</code> |
| <code>supportingTextVisibility</code><br><span class="gb-desc">When the supporting text shows: <code>always</code> (default), or <code>focus</code> only while the field has focus (text-fields-aed1bf). Its space stays reserved so the layout does not move, it stays in the input's accessible description, and an error message always shows.</span> | <code>supporting-text-visibility</code> | <code>SupportingTextVisibility</code> | <code>'always'</code> |
| <code>textDirection</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Overrides the input's CSS <code>direction</code>.</span> | <code>text-direction</code> | <code>string</code> | <code>''</code> |
| <code>type</code><br><span class="gb-desc">The input type, <code>text</code> by default. <code>textarea</code> renders a multi-line <code>&lt;textarea&gt;</code>.</span> | <code>type</code> | <code>TextFieldType | UnsupportedTextFieldType</code> | <code>'text'</code> |
| <code>value</code><br><span class="gb-desc">The current value. It is always a string.</span> | <code>value</code> | <code>string</code> | <code>''</code> |
| <code>variant</code><br><span class="gb-desc">The variant: <code>filled</code> (default) or <code>outlined</code>.</span> | <code>variant</code> | <code>TextFieldVariant</code> | <code>'filled'</code> |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| <code>leading-icon</code> | An icon (or icon button) before the input. |
| <code>trailing-icon</code> | An icon (or icon button) after the input, such as a clear, visibility or error icon. |

#### Events

| Event | Description |
| --- | --- |
| <code>change</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Event</span> | The native <code>change</code> event. |
| <code>input</code><br><span class="gb-desc">InputEvent</span> | The native <code>input</code> event. |
| <code>invalid</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Event</span> | Fired when <code>checkValidity()</code> or <code>reportValidity()</code> finds the field invalid. |
| <code>select</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Event</span> | The native <code>select</code> event. |

#### Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| <code>focus</code><br><span class="gb-desc">(options?: FocusOptions) =&gt; void</span> | [MDN Reference](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/HTMLElement/focus) |
| <code>reset</code><br><span class="gb-desc">() =&gt; void</span> | Resets the value to the <code>value</code> attribute and clears native errors. |
| <code>select</code><br><span class="gb-desc">() =&gt; void</span> | Selects all the text. |
| <code>setCustomValidity</code><br><span class="gb-desc">(error: string) =&gt; void</span> | Sets the element's constraint validation error message. When set to a non-empty string, <code>validity.customError</code> will be true and <code>validationMessage</code> will display the provided error. Use this method to customize error messages reported. https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLInputElement/setCustomValidity |
| <code>setRangeText</code><br><span class="gb-desc">&#123; (replacement: string): void; (replacement: string, start: number, end: number, selectionMode?: SelectionMode): void; &#125;</span> | Replaces a range of text with a new string. |
| <code>setSelectionRange</code><br><span class="gb-desc">(start: number, end: number, direction?: "none" | "forward" | "backward") =&gt; void</span> | Sets the start and end of the text selection. |
| <code>showPicker</code><br><span class="gb-desc">() =&gt; void</span> | Shows the browser picker of a date, time or color field. |
| <code>stepDown</code><br><span class="gb-desc">(n?: number) =&gt; void</span> | Decrements a numeric value by <code>step</code>, <code>n</code> times. |
| <code>stepUp</code><br><span class="gb-desc">(n?: number) =&gt; void</span> | Increments a numeric value by <code>step</code>, <code>n</code> times. |

#### CSS parts

| Part | Description |
| --- | --- |
| <code>::part(container)</code> | The field's container. |
| <code>::part(counter)</code> | The character counter. |
| <code>::part(input)</code> | The native <code>&lt;input&gt;</code> or <code>&lt;textarea&gt;</code>. |
| <code>::part(label)</code> | The floating label. |
| <code>::part(supporting-text)</code> | The supporting or error text. |

| <code>--density-step</code> | Container height removed per density step. |
| <code>--icon-input-space</code> | Space between an icon and the input. |
| <code>--icon-leading-space</code> | Start padding before a leading icon. |
| <code>--icon-trailing-space</code> | End padding after a trailing icon. |
| <code>--input-text</code> | Input typography. |
| <code>--input-text-axes</code> | Input font variation settings. |
| <code>--input-text-color</code> | Input text color. |
| <code>--input-text-placeholder-color</code> | Placeholder color. |
| <code>--input-text-prefix-color</code> | Prefix text color. |
| <code>--input-text-suffix-color</code> | Suffix text color. |
| <code>--input-text-tracking</code> | Input letter spacing. |
| <code>--label-text</code> | Resting label typography. |
| <code>--label-text-axes</code> | Label font variation settings. |
| <code>--label-text-color</code> | Label color. |
| <code>--label-text-populated-line-height</code> | Floated label line height. |
| <code>--label-text-populated-size</code> | Floated label font size. |
| <code>--label-text-tracking</code> | Label letter spacing. |
| <code>--leading-icon-color</code> | Leading icon color. |
| <code>--leading-icon-size</code> | Leading icon size. |
| <code>--leading-space</code> | Start padding without a leading icon. |
| <code>--outline-color</code> | Outlined container outline color. |
| <code>--outline-label-padding</code> | Space around the floated label in the outline notch. |
| <code>--outline-width</code> | Outlined container outline width. |

| <code>--trailing-space</code> | End padding without a trailing icon. |

# Toolbar

A toolbar holds actions that relate to the content on the screen, docked to an edge or floating above it.

**Example: A floating toolbar with formatting actions**

```html
<md-gb-toolbar aria-label="Text formatting">
  <md-gb-icon-button aria-label="Bold"><md-gb-icon>format_bold</md-gb-icon></md-gb-icon-button>
  <md-gb-icon-button aria-label="Italic"><md-gb-icon>format_italic</md-gb-icon></md-gb-icon-button>
  <md-gb-icon-button aria-label="Underline"><md-gb-icon>format_underlined</md-gb-icon></md-gb-icon-button>
</md-gb-toolbar>
```

## Usage guidelines

*   **Actions for the page.** A toolbar offers actions related to the current page and can show more of them in larger windows.
*   **Docked or floating.** A [docked](#docked) toolbar spans the window and suits global actions that stay the same across pages. A floating toolbar hovers over the content and suits actions for that content.
*   **Vibrant for emphasis.** Use the [vibrant](#colors) color for more emphasis.
*   **Not with a navigation bar.** Don't show a toolbar at the same time as a navigation bar.

## Anatomy

A toolbar holds actions, such as buttons and icon buttons. A floating toolbar can have a FAB.

**Example: A toolbar with leading and trailing buttons, a button and a FAB**

```html
<md-gb-toolbar aria-label="Compose actions">
  <md-gb-icon-button slot="leading" aria-label="Attach"><md-gb-icon>attach_file</md-gb-icon></md-gb-icon-button>
  <md-gb-button>Draft</md-gb-button>
  <md-gb-icon-button slot="trailing" aria-label="Delete"><md-gb-icon>delete</md-gb-icon></md-gb-icon-button>
  <md-gb-fab slot="fab" aria-label="Send"><md-gb-icon>send</md-gb-icon></md-gb-fab>
</md-gb-toolbar>
```

## Examples

### Colors

Toolbars are `standard` by default. Set `color="vibrant"` for a more prominent toolbar.

**Example: A vibrant toolbar**

```html
<md-gb-toolbar color="vibrant" aria-label="Editing">
  <md-gb-icon-button aria-label="Undo"><md-gb-icon>undo</md-gb-icon></md-gb-icon-button>
  <md-gb-icon-button aria-label="Redo"><md-gb-icon>redo</md-gb-icon></md-gb-icon-button>
</md-gb-toolbar>
```

### Docked

Add `docked` to stretch the toolbar across the full width of its container.

**Example: A docked toolbar**

```html
<md-gb-toolbar docked aria-label="Editing">
  <md-gb-icon-button aria-label="Undo"><md-gb-icon>undo</md-gb-icon></md-gb-icon-button>
  <md-gb-icon-button aria-label="Redo"><md-gb-icon>redo</md-gb-icon></md-gb-icon-button>
  <md-gb-icon-button aria-label="Share"><md-gb-icon>share</md-gb-icon></md-gb-icon-button>
</md-gb-toolbar>
```

### Buttons with labels

Toolbars can hold buttons with labels as well as icon buttons. Use toggle buttons to show a selected state.

**Example: A toolbar with toggle buttons**

```html
<md-gb-toolbar aria-label="View">
  <md-gb-button type="toggle" selected>
    <md-gb-icon>edit</md-gb-icon>
    Edit
  </md-gb-button>
  <md-gb-button type="toggle">
    <md-gb-icon>palette</md-gb-icon>
    Style
  </md-gb-button>
</md-gb-toolbar>
```

### Orientation

Set `orientation="vertical"` to stack the actions in a column.

**Example: A vertical toolbar**

```html
<md-gb-toolbar orientation="vertical" aria-label="Tools">
  <md-gb-icon-button aria-label="Draw"><md-gb-icon>brush</md-gb-icon></md-gb-icon-button>
  <md-gb-icon-button aria-label="Erase"><md-gb-icon>ink_eraser</md-gb-icon></md-gb-icon-button>
</md-gb-toolbar>
```

### With a FAB

A floating toolbar can sit beside a FAB in the `fab` slot. Set `fab-position="start"` to move it to the leading side, or `expanded="false"` to collapse the toolbar to just the FAB.

**Example: A floating toolbar with a FAB**

```html
<md-gb-toolbar aria-label="Compose actions">
  <md-gb-icon-button aria-label="Attach"><md-gb-icon>attach_file</md-gb-icon></md-gb-icon-button>
  <md-gb-icon-button aria-label="Insert photo"><md-gb-icon>image</md-gb-icon></md-gb-icon-button>
  <md-gb-fab slot="fab" aria-label="Send"><md-gb-icon>send</md-gb-icon></md-gb-fab>
</md-gb-toolbar>
```

### Overflow

Add `overflow-menu` to move trailing actions that don't fit into a "More actions" menu.

**Example: A narrow toolbar with an overflow menu**

```html
<md-gb-toolbar overflow-menu aria-label="Document actions" style="max-inline-size: 200px">
  <md-gb-icon-button aria-label="Print"><md-gb-icon>print</md-gb-icon></md-gb-icon-button>
  <md-gb-icon-button slot="trailing" aria-label="Share"><md-gb-icon>share</md-gb-icon></md-gb-icon-button>
  <md-gb-icon-button slot="trailing" aria-label="Download"><md-gb-icon>download</md-gb-icon></md-gb-icon-button>
  <md-gb-icon-button slot="trailing" aria-label="Delete"><md-gb-icon>delete</md-gb-icon></md-gb-icon-button>
</md-gb-toolbar>
```

### Hide on scroll

Set `scroll-behavior="hide"` to move a docked or floating toolbar off screen when the page scrolls down and bring it back when it scrolls up. `scroll-target` names the element that scrolls; it defaults to the window.

**Example: A docked toolbar that hides when its page scrolls down**

*HTML*

```html
<div id="page">
  <p>Scroll this page down to hide the toolbar and up to bring it back.</p>
  <p>Bread, milk, eggs, butter, cheese, apples, rice, beans, flour, sugar.</p>
  <p>Coffee, tea, honey, oats, lentils, pasta, tomatoes, onions, garlic.</p>
  <p>Lemons, limes, oranges, bananas, grapes, pears, plums, peaches, figs.</p>
  <md-gb-toolbar docked scroll-behavior="hide" scroll-target="page" aria-label="Page actions">
    <md-gb-icon-button aria-label="Undo"><md-gb-icon>undo</md-gb-icon></md-gb-icon-button>
    <md-gb-icon-button aria-label="Share"><md-gb-icon>share</md-gb-icon></md-gb-icon-button>
  </md-gb-toolbar>
</div>
```

*CSS*

```css
#page {
  block-size: 200px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  padding-inline: 16px;
}
#page md-gb-toolbar {
  position: sticky;
  inset-block-end: 0;
}
#page p {
  margin-block: 56px;
}
```

## Accessibility

*   A toolbar has the `toolbar` role. Label it with [`aria-label`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Accessibility/ARIA/Attributes/aria-label) or [`aria-labelledby`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Accessibility/ARIA/Attributes/aria-labelledby).
*   Every action stays in the Tab order, and the arrow keys also move between them (up and down in a vertical toolbar).
*   Icon-only actions need an `aria-label`.
*   A collapsed toolbar makes its hidden actions inert.

## API reference

### &lt;md-gb-toolbar&gt;

A Material Design gBreeze toolbar custom element.

#### Properties

| Property | Attribute | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <code>color</code><br><span class="gb-desc">The color scheme of the toolbar.</span> | <code>color</code> | <code>ToolbarColor</code> | <code>'standard'</code> |
| <code>docked</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Whether the toolbar is docked across full width.</span> | <code>docked</code> | <code>boolean</code> | <code>false</code> |
| <code>expanded</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Whether a floating toolbar with a FAB shows its items. When <code>false</code>, the toolbar collapses and its FAB grows to the medium size (Compose floating toolbar <code>expanded</code>). Set <code>expanded="false"</code> from markup.</span> | <code>expanded</code> | <code>boolean</code> | <code>true</code> |
| <code>fabPosition</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Which side of a floating toolbar the FAB is on (<code>end</code> or <code>start</code>).</span> | <code>fab-position</code> | <code>"start" | "end"</code> | <code>'end'</code> |
| <code>orientation</code><br><span class="gb-desc">The layout orientation.</span> | <code>orientation</code> | <code>ToolbarOrientation</code> | <code>'horizontal'</code> |
| <code>overflowMenu</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Whether trailing actions that do not fit move into an overflow menu in the trailing slot (toolbars.md, Adaptive design). On by itself when an <code>overflow</code> slot trigger is provided; this turns it on with the default "More actions" button.</span> | <code>overflow-menu</code> | <code>boolean</code> | <code>false</code> |
| <code>scrollBehavior</code><br><span class="gb-desc">How a docked or floating toolbar reacts to scrolling: <code>hide</code> slides it beyond the bottom edge when the page scrolls down and back on scroll up (toolbars.md: docked and floating toolbars "can animate offscreen").</span> | <code>scroll-behavior</code> | <code>"hide"</code> |  |
| <code>scrollTarget</code><br><span class="gb-desc">The id of the element whose scrolling drives <code>scroll-behavior</code>. Defaults to the window.</span> | <code>scroll-target</code> | <code>string</code> | <code>''</code> |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| default | Used to display toolbar items (buttons, icon buttons, or custom content). |
| <code>fab</code> | An optional FAB (<code>md-gb-fab</code>) shown next to a floating toolbar, colored by the toolbar's <code>color</code> (standard: secondary container, vibrant: tertiary container). |
| <code>leading</code> | Used to display leading toolbar items. |
| <code>trailing</code> | Used to display trailing toolbar items. |

#### CSS parts

| Part | Description |
| --- | --- |
| <code>::part(toolbar)</code> | The toolbar's root container. |
| <code>::part(toolbar-with-fab)</code> | The toolbar and FAB layout, with a FAB. |

#### CSS custom properties

| Property | Description |
| --- | --- |
| <code>--button-container-color</code> |  |
| <code>--container-color</code> |  |
| <code>--container-elevation</code> |  |
| <code>--container-leading-space</code> |  |
| <code>--container-shape</code> |  |
| <code>--container-spacing</code> |  |
| <code>--container-trailing-space</code> |  |
| <code>--docked-container-elevation</code> |  |
| <code>--docked-container-height</code> |  |
| <code>--docked-container-leading-space</code> |  |
| <code>--docked-container-max-spacing</code> |  |
| <code>--docked-container-min-spacing</code> |  |
| <code>--docked-container-shape</code> |  |
| <code>--docked-container-trailing-space</code> |  |
| <code>--horizontal-container-height</code> |  |
| <code>--icon-color</code> |  |
| <code>--label-text-color</code> |  |
| <code>--min-button-size</code> |  |
| <code>--motion-duration</code> |  |
| <code>--motion-easing</code> |  |
| <code>--selected-button-container-color</code> |  |
| <code>--selected-icon-color</code> |  |
| <code>--selected-label-text-color</code> |  |
| <code>--vertical-container-width</code> |  |

Source: https://material-web.dev/3.0/components/tooltip/

# Tooltip

Tooltips add context to a button or other element, as a short plain label or a richer panel with a subhead and actions.

**Example: A plain tooltip on an icon button**

```html
<md-gb-icon-button id="edit" aria-label="Edit">
  <md-gb-icon>edit</md-gb-icon>
</md-gb-icon-button>
<md-gb-tooltip for="edit">Edit</md-gb-tooltip>
```

## Usage guidelines

*   **Plain to label.** Use a [plain](#placement) tooltip to name an element with no text, such as an icon-only button. Don't add one when the element already has a visible label.
*   **Rich for details.** Use a [rich](#rich) tooltip for longer text, such as a definition or an explanation of a new feature, with an optional subhead and up to two text buttons.
*   **Nothing critical.** Tooltips are easy to miss, so never hide information people must see. Use a dialog for that.

## Anatomy

A tooltip points at an anchor element by its id. A rich tooltip can add a subhead and actions.

**Example: A rich tooltip with a subhead, text and an action, open on a button**

*HTML*

```html
<button id="anchor">Storage</button>
<md-gb-tooltip for="anchor" variant="rich" persistent>
  <span slot="subhead">Storage</span>
  Photos and files you keep in your account.
  <md-gb-button slot="action" color="text">Manage</md-gb-button>
</md-gb-tooltip>
```

*JavaScript*

```js
document.querySelector('md-gb-tooltip').show();
```

## Examples

### Placement

A plain tooltip opens above its anchor and a rich one below it. Set `placement` to `above`, `below`, `start` or `end`; it flips when there isn't room. Add `caret` to point at the anchor.

**Example: A plain tooltip with a caret, placed below its anchor**

```html
<md-gb-icon-button id="share" aria-label="Share">
  <md-gb-icon>share</md-gb-icon>
</md-gb-icon-button>
<md-gb-tooltip for="share" placement="below" caret>Share</md-gb-tooltip>
```

### Rich

Set `variant="rich"` and a `subhead`. Text buttons go in the `action` slot.

**Example: A rich tooltip with a subhead and an action**

```html
<md-gb-button id="grant" color="outlined">Grant value</md-gb-button>
<md-gb-tooltip for="grant" variant="rich" subhead="How it's calculated">
  Uses the closing stock price from the day before the grant date.
  <md-gb-button slot="action" color="text">Learn more</md-gb-button>
</md-gb-tooltip>
```

### Persistent

A `persistent` rich tooltip opens when the anchor is clicked and stays open until someone interacts with something else, so people can reach its actions.

**Example: A rich tooltip that opens on click**

```html
<md-gb-button id="whats-new" color="tonal">What's new</md-gb-button>
<md-gb-tooltip for="whats-new" variant="rich" persistent subhead="Shared folders">
  Invite others to a folder and work on files together.
  <md-gb-button slot="action" color="text">Got it</md-gb-button>
</md-gb-tooltip>
```

### Delays

A tooltip opens right away and closes 1.5 seconds after the pointer leaves. Set `show-delay` and `hide-delay` in milliseconds, or add `quick` to skip the motion.

**Example: A tooltip that closes after half a second**

```html
<md-gb-icon-button id="delete" aria-label="Delete">
  <md-gb-icon>delete</md-gb-icon>
</md-gb-icon-button>
<md-gb-tooltip for="delete" hide-delay="500">Delete</md-gb-tooltip>
```

## Accessibility

*   A plain tooltip is a `tooltip` that describes its anchor, and it opens on hover and on keyboard focus. Keep the anchor's own accessible name, such as an `aria-label` on an icon button.
*   A rich tooltip with actions is a `dialog`, so its buttons can be reached with the keyboard.
*   Escape closes an open tooltip.
*   Don't put information in a tooltip that people can't find another way, since touch users can't hover.

## API reference

### &lt;md-gb-tooltip&gt;

A Material Design plain or rich tooltip.

#### Properties

| Property | Attribute | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <code>align</code><br><span class="gb-desc">How the tooltip lines up with its anchor along the placement side: <code>center</code> (plain default) or <code>start</code> (rich default). A rich tooltip can be <code>center</code>ed below its anchor on desktop.</span> | <code>align</code> | <code>"" | "start" | "center"</code> | <code>''</code> |
| <code>caret</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Whether to draw a caret pointing at the anchor.</span> | <code>caret</code> | <code>boolean</code> | <code>false</code> |
| <code>hideDelay</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Delay before hiding after the pointer leaves, in milliseconds.</span> | <code>hide-delay</code> | <code>number</code> | <code>TOOLTIP_HIDE_DELAY_MS</code> |
| <code>htmlFor</code><br><span class="gb-desc">The id of the anchor element, in the same root as the tooltip.</span> | <code>for</code> | <code>string</code> | <code>''</code> |
| <code>noBoundary</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Plain only: the anchor has no visual boundary, such as a text baseline, so the tooltip sits 8dp from it instead of 4dp.</span> | <code>no-boundary</code> | <code>boolean</code> | <code>false</code> |
| <code>open</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Whether the tooltip is open.</span> | <code>open</code> | <code>boolean</code> |  |
| <code>persistent</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Rich only: opens when the anchor is clicked instead of on hover / focus, and stays open until the user interacts with another element.</span> | <code>persistent</code> | <code>boolean</code> | <code>false</code> |
| <code>placement</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Preferred side of the anchor. Defaults to <code>above</code> for plain tooltips and <code>below</code> for rich ones. Flips when there isn't room.</span> | <code>placement</code> | <code>"" | TooltipPlacement</code> | <code>''</code> |
| <code>quick</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Skips the open / close animation.</span> | <code>quick</code> | <code>boolean</code> | <code>false</code> |
| <code>showDelay</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Hover delay before showing, in milliseconds.</span> | <code>show-delay</code> | <code>number</code> | <code>TOOLTIP_SHOW_DELAY_MS</code> |
| <code>subhead</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Rich only: subhead text. Replaced by content in the <code>subhead</code> slot.</span> | <code>subhead</code> | <code>string</code> | <code>''</code> |
| <code>variant</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Plain or rich.</span> | <code>variant</code> | <code>TooltipVariant</code> | <code>TOOLTIP_VARIANTS.plain</code> |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| default | The supporting text. |
| <code>action</code> | Rich tooltip text buttons (up to two), e.g. <code>&lt;md-gb-button color="text"&gt;</code>. |
| <code>subhead</code> | Rich tooltip subhead; replaces the <code>subhead</code> attribute. |

#### Events

| Event | Description |
| --- | --- |
| <code>close</code><br><span class="gb-desc">CustomEvent&lt;&#123;reason: string&#125;&gt;</span> | Fired before the tooltip closes. Cancelable. |
| <code>closed</code><br><span class="gb-desc">CustomEvent&lt;&#123;reason: string&#125;&gt;</span> | Fired after the tooltip closes. |
| <code>open</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Event</span> | Fired before the tooltip opens. Cancelable. |
| <code>opened</code><br><span class="gb-desc">Event</span> | Fired after the tooltip opens. |

#### Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| <code>hide</code><br><span class="gb-desc">() =&gt; void</span> | Closes the tooltip. |
| <code>reposition</code><br><span class="gb-desc">() =&gt; void</span> | Recomputes the tooltip's position next to its anchor. |
| <code>show</code><br><span class="gb-desc">() =&gt; void</span> | Opens the tooltip, closing any other open tooltip. |

#### CSS parts

| Part | Description |
| --- | --- |
| <code>::part(actions)</code> | The actions container. |
| <code>::part(caret)</code> | The caret. |
| <code>::part(subhead)</code> | The subhead container. |
| <code>::part(supporting-text)</code> | The supporting text container. |
| <code>::part(tooltip)</code> | The tooltip surface. |

#### CSS custom properties

| Property | Description |
| --- | --- |
| <code>--action-label-text</code> | Rich action typography. |
| <code>--action-label-text-axes</code> | Rich action font variation settings. |
| <code>--action-label-text-color</code> | Rich action label color. |
| <code>--action-label-text-tracking</code> | Rich action letter spacing. |
| <code>--actions-gap</code> | Space between rich actions. |
| <code>--actions-padding-block-end</code> | Rich container bottom padding below actions. |
| <code>--actions-spacing</code> | Space above the rich actions. |
| <code>--anchor-spacing</code> | Distance between the anchor and the tooltip (or its caret). |
| <code>--caret-height</code> | Caret height. |
| <code>--caret-width</code> | Caret base width. |
| <code>--container-color</code> | Container color. |
| <code>--container-elevation</code> | Container box shadow. |
| <code>--container-shape</code> | Container corner radius. |
| <code>--max-width</code> | Maximum container width. |
| <code>--min-height</code> | Minimum container height. |
| <code>--min-width</code> | Minimum container width. |
| <code>--padding-block</code> | Container block padding. |
| <code>--padding-inline</code> | Container inline padding. |
| <code>--subhead</code> | Rich subhead typography. |
| <code>--subhead-axes</code> | Rich subhead font variation settings. |
| <code>--subhead-color</code> | Rich subhead color. |
| <code>--subhead-spacing</code> | Space below the rich subhead. |
| <code>--subhead-tracking</code> | Rich subhead letter spacing. |
| <code>--supporting-text</code> | Supporting text typography. |
| <code>--supporting-text-axes</code> | Supporting text font variation settings. |
| <code>--supporting-text-color</code> | Supporting text color. |
| <code>--supporting-text-tracking</code> | Supporting text letter spacing. |
| <code>--viewport-margin</code> | Minimum distance from the viewport edges. |
